purpose: Teach: 売り込み/給水/消火/手掛け/綴る/祭祀/即位/レポーター

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマの、本気で、絶対、売り込み、絶対、教授に、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — you need to pitch your research theme to the professor. Seriously. Make it happen.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Lean forward slightly on the name. Firm emphasis on the core request. The tone of someone who expects compliance because he knows you're capable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、本気で、絶対、給水、絶対、設備、絶対、整備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. The lab equipment and water systems — I'm making sure everything is maintained and running smoothly. Thank you for pushing me on this.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not performative — this is how Ren speaks to people he trusts. Slight lift of relief at being able to report progress. Careful precision in each phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験室の、本気で、絶対、消火、絶対、設備、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And the fire safety equipment in the lab — I need you to verify it's all in order. This one matters.
lines.style: Lower register. The authority shifts to something more serious. Not angry, but the urgency is unmistakable. A pause after 'lab' — letting that sink in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授が、本気で、絶対、手掛けて、絶対、いる、絶対、新テーマ、絶対、私も、絶対、参加しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The professor has a new research direction he's developing, and I've already started participating. I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Earnest and straightforward. Ren is pleased to report genuine progress, not just compliance. Slight warmth — this is work he actually cares about. Tempo steady and clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究日誌を、本気で、絶対、綴る、絶対、習慣を、絶対、続けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep up the research journal. Make it a habit. That's the one that sticks with you.
lines.style: Quieter now. This isn't a demand — it's advice. The voice of someone who knows what actually matters in the long term. A slight settling, almost conversational, but still authoritative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、祭祀、絶対、研究、絶対、フィールドワーク、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm conducting fieldwork on local ritual practices — combining archival research with interviews and observation. I appreciate your guidance on the methodology.
lines.style: Animated underneath the politeness. Ren is describing work he's genuinely excited about. Slight quickening of pace when listing the components. Respectful, but there's energy here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学長の、本気で、絶対、即位、絶対、講演、絶対、参加しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: You should attend the university president's inaugural lecture. It's worth your time.
lines.style: Direct and simple. No extra weight. This is a straightforward suggestion from someone older who knows the value of witnessing these moments. Brief. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学術誌の、本気で、絶対、レポーター、絶対、私の研究、絶対、取材、絶対、来ていただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. A reporter from an academic journal came and covered my research. I'm very grateful for that opportunity.
lines.style: Genuine surprise and pleasure underneath the formality. This is a moment — and Ren knows it. Voice steadies with pride. A closing note of gratitude that feels earned and real, not just polite.
